name: ballerinax/solace
description: Solace PubSub+ is a powerful event broker that supports multiple protocols and messaging patterns. It provides high-performance, reliable, and scalable messaging for modern event-driven architectures. The Solace connector allows you to integrate with Solace event brokers, enabling efficient event distribution across various environments.

typeDefs.name: DIRECT
typeDefs.description:
At-most-once delivery mode. Direct messages are not retained for disconnected clients and can be discarded
during congestion or failures. They can be reordered during network topology changes.
Most appropriate for high-rate, low-latency messaging applications.

typeDefs.name: PERSISTENT
typeDefs.description:
Once-and-only-once delivery mode for Guaranteed Messaging. Persistent messages cannot be lost once acknowledged,
cannot be reordered during topology changes, and cannot be delivered more than once (unless redelivered flag is set).
Retained on durable endpoints for disconnected clients. Recommended for applications requiring persistent storage
and reliable message delivery.

Detach a service from the listener.

Stops and closes the flow/consumer associated with the service.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The service object to detach

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Start the listener.

Begins delivering messages to all attached services.

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Gracefully stop the listener.

Stops delivery to attached services and waits for in-flight message processing to complete
before closing resources.

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Immediately stop the listener.

Stops delivery and closes resources without waiting for in-flight processing.

clients.name: Caller
clients.description:
Caller for explicit acknowledgement and transaction control within a service's `onMessage` method.

A `Caller` is created by the `solace:Listener` and supplied as the optional second parameter of
`onMessage`. Use it when the service is configured with `ackMode = CLIENT_ACK` and needs manual
acknowledgement, or when the listener connection is transacted and needs commit/rollback control.

functions.name: ack
functions.description:
Acknowledge a message in `CLIENT_ACK` mode.

In `AUTO_ACK` mode messages are acknowledged automatically after `onMessage` returns
successfully and this method should not be called. When the listener connection is transacted,
settlement is governed by `commit`/`rollback`, so this method does not apply.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to acknowledge

functions.name: nack
functions.description:
Negatively acknowledge a message (NACK).

When the listener connection is transacted, this method returns an `Error`: JCSMP's settle()
is a documented no-op on transacted flows, so calling `nack` there would silently have no
effect. Use `commit`/`rollback` instead to control settlement.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to negatively acknowledge

parameters.name: requeue
parameters.description:
If true, the message is requeued for redelivery (FAILED outcome).
If false, the message moves to the DMQ immediately, if configured. If not, the message is simply
discarded. (REJECTED outcome)

functions.name: 'commit
functions.description:
Commit the current transaction.

Only applicable when the listener connection is transacted.

functions.name: 'rollback
functions.description:
Rollback the current transaction.

Only applicable when the listener connection is transacted.

functions.name: receive
functions.description:
Receive a message with a timeout.

Blocks up to the specified timeout waiting for a message. Returns nil if no message
arrives within the timeout period.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a message. A nil or zero timeout never expires

parameters.name: T
parameters.description:
Optional type description of the expected message type; declare a narrowed
`record {|*Message; T payload;|}` to have the payload data-bound into `T`

type.name: record {|anydata payload; solace:DeliveryMode deliveryMode; int priority?; decimal timeToLive?; string messageId?; string messageType?; string correlationId?; solace:Destination replyTo?; string senderId?; int senderTimestamp?; int sequenceNumber?; map<solace:Property> properties?; byte[] userData?; int receiveTimestamp?; boolean redelivered?; solace:Destination destination?; int deliveryCount?; int expiration?;|}

return.description: The received message, or nil if timeout occurs; Error if receive fails

functions.name: receiveNoWait
functions.description:
Receive a message without waiting.

Returns immediately with a message if available, or nil if no message is available.
This is a non-blocking operation.

parameters.name: T
parameters.description:
Optional type description of the expected message type; declare a narrowed
`record {|*Message; T payload;|}` to have the payload data-bound into `T`

type.name: record {|anydata payload; solace:DeliveryMode deliveryMode; int priority?; decimal timeToLive?; string messageId?; string messageType?; string correlationId?; solace:Destination replyTo?; string senderId?; int senderTimestamp?; int sequenceNumber?; map<solace:Property> properties?; byte[] userData?; int receiveTimestamp?; boolean redelivered?; solace:Destination destination?; int deliveryCount?; int expiration?;|}

return.description: The received message, or nil if no message available; Error if receive fails

functions.name: ack
functions.description:
Acknowledge a message in CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE mode.

Only use this method if the subscription is configured with ackMode = CLIENT_ACK.
In AUTO mode, messages are acknowledged automatically.

For transacted flows, calling this method has no effect.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to acknowledge

functions.name: nack
functions.description:
Negatively acknowledge a message (NACK).

Sends a negative acknowledgement for the message, indicating processing failure.

Only use this method if the subscription is configured with ackMode = CLIENT_ACK
and the consumer flow is configured to support required settlement outcomes.
For transacted flows, settlement outcomes are ignored.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to negatively acknowledge

parameters.name: requeue
parameters.description:
If true (default), the message is made available for redelivery. (FAILED outcome)
If false, the message moves to the DMQ immediately, if configured.
If not configured, the message is simply discarded. (REJECTED outcome)

functions.name: 'commit
functions.description:
Commit the current transaction.

Only applicable in transacted mode. Commits all message operations since the last commit/rollback.

functions.name: 'rollback
functions.description:
Rollback the current transaction.

Only applicable in transacted mode. Rolls back all message operations since the last commit/rollback.

services.name: Service
services.description: Consumes messages delivered from the queue or topic named in @solace:ServiceConfig.

listener.name: solace:Listener
listener.description: Connects to a Solace PubSub+ broker and dispatches each delivered message to the attached service.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The broker URL with format: [protocol:]host[:port]

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The connection configuration (auth, SSL/TLS, retry, etc.)

constraints.message: A Solace service needs its subscription from exactly one source: @solace:ServiceConfig { queueName } for a queue or @solace:ServiceConfig { topicName } for a topic.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Invoked once per message delivered from the queue or topic named in @solace:ServiceConfig. Declare a narrower payload type to project the message payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The delivered message. Declare a narrower type to project the payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Handle for explicit acknowledgement and transaction control. Needed only when the service's ackMode is CLIENT_ACK (for caller->ack/caller->nack) or the listener's connection is transacted (for caller->commit/caller->rollback).

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Invoked when a delivered message cannot be dispatched to onMessage, most commonly because its payload fails to bind to a declared narrowed payload type.

parameters.name: err
parameters.description: The failure that prevented dispatch.

annotations.name: ServiceConfig
annotations.description:
The service configuration annotation for a Solace service attached to a `solace:Listener`.

Specifies the subscription (queue or topic) and the flow options for the service.
Exactly one of `queueName` or `topicName` must be provided.
